choices: synchronized cannot be used inside lambdas
Thread t1 and t2 may each acquire one lock and wait for the other, causing deadlock
lock1 and lock2 must be the same object
explanation: t1 acquires lock1 then waits for lock2. t2 acquires lock2 then waits for lock1. Each holds what the other needs — circular wait = deadlock. Fix: always acquire locks in the same order in all threads.
